nonNoop: Position on node/label/port overrides its location.
Child minimum-size resize occurs only when that child has a position option.
resizeNode_1 moves ports/labels and clears internal constraints.
Edge bend-chain may create/replace section geometry; bounds use bendpoints and labels but not endpoints.
ORTHOGONAL invokes real shared-port junction calculation and demands one section.
Parent bounds add padding without unconditionally shifting node positions.
unresolvedObservedOddities: processEdge multi-section removal loop calls remove before next; preserve observed official failure rather than repair.
Port side/label ratio divisions follow JS IEEE754 edge cases; host adapter must preserve guarded behavior.

hostProviderBoundary.interface: layout_fixed(graph, options=None, *, monitor=None) -> new JSON graph
hostProviderBoundary.provider: real ported arithmetic/ordered processing; no subprocess/JS/JVM/native backend
hostProviderBoundary.centralHost: clone/import/default materialization/property resolution/recursive engine/caller-input preservation/export identity
hostProviderBoundary.notYetClaimed: No global registration/support announcement. Missing shared model branches remain pending until implementation and independent observations.

facts: SIMPLE stable sort priority descending, then optional y/x ascending, then area ascending.
Grouping modes have their own area ordering, merges and resize operations.
SAMPLE area standard deviation divides by n-1 with JS IEEE754 semantics.
GROUP_MIXED must preserve generated heapify/merge and equal-priority tie order.
Only the last box in each SIMPLE expanded row receives contentAlignment translation; grouping uses its distinct inner-node translation.

fixedSourceOddities: edge targetShape reads sources[0], not targets[0]
source/target port paths add owner.x twice to x, without adding owner.y
parent width/height receive padding sums twice
randomFacts.floatCast: $floatValue is identity; no arbitrary float32 truncation of user values. Defaults retain intern103/intern136 exact decimals.
